$Comment: The Hallowed set: a Jack Helm worn and a Jack Shield in the utility slot. Members holds both helms (the Jack Helm and the Burning Jack Helm) and both shields (the Jack Shield and the Flaming Jack Shield), so any helm with any shield completes it. Its one tier asks for exactly that, Armor 1 and Utility 1, so a shield carried in the main hand never counts. While it holds, the tier adds Health and favor with the Hallowed reputation (the stat Reputation_Hallows_Eve_Hallowed) and puts on the set's effect, Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Set, which carries the glow and the fire ward, and its Badge, Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Badge, the set's one tile on the buff bar. Raise or lower the Amount to tune the set; under Parent the Bonuses list replaces whole, so restate the tier you keep. The text keys live in hallowseve.items.lang.
